question: Marianne's avocado oil brand manufacturer
markdown:
Marianne's avocado oil is produced by
Marianne's Harvest Brands
(often branded simply as
Marianne's
), which is operated by a fifth-generation, family-owned food company
based in Woodland, California.
Brand Background and Quality
Heritage
: Rooted in five generations of family food expertise and traditional integrity.
Purity Standard
: Gained industry prominence when a University of California, Davis study used it as the benchmark standard for 100% pure, unadulterated avocado oil.
Instagram
Mariannes Harvest
Certifications
: Recognized as a Seed Oil Free Certified® brand and recipient of the Clean Label Project Purity Award.
Instagram
mariannesharvest
Sourcing
: Avocados are grown and harvested primarily in Mexico, then processed into high-heat cooking oils (with a 500°F smoke point) and sprays.
